body.p: In a cave on Gable Island in the Beagle Channel there was a monster which assaulted all the canoes that passed near its lair and ate those who manned them. A young man, short of stature and very skilled in the handling of the harpoon and the arrow, resolved to rid the country of this monster and alone in his canoe went to meet it at the entrance of the cavern. The monster, on seeing him, rushed upon him, but the bold Indian, without being frightened, with several stones thrown skillfully by his sling, burst his eyes. Then the monster was blinded, and he finished it off with his harpoons.
